# omadafusion_gateway_acl (Resource)

A rule in the site's gateway ACL table (Network Security > ACL > Gateway ACL), using the controller's site-level ACL mode. New rules are appended to the end of the table; order is reported in `index`. Rule names must be unique so a new rule can be identified after creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_lan_network" "staff" {
  name = "Staff"
}

data "omadafusion_lan_network" "management" {
  name = "Management"
}

# Staff cannot open connections to Management, but replies to connections
# that Management opens still pass.
resource "omadafusion_gateway_acl" "staff_to_management" {
  name            = "Deny Staff to Management"
  policy          = "deny"
  protocols       = ["all"]
  source_ids      = [data.omadafusion_lan_network.staff.id]
  destination_ids = [data.omadafusion_lan_network.management.id]
  match_states    = ["new"]
}

# Block Staff from the gateway's admin pages. destination_type 5 matches all
# traffic addressed to the gateway, so limit it to TCP to keep DNS/DHCP/ping.
resource "omadafusion_gateway_acl" "staff_to_gateway_admin" {
  name             = "Deny Staff to gateway management"
  policy           = "deny"
  protocols        = ["tcp"]
  source_ids       = [data.omadafusion_lan_network.staff.id]
  destination_type = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Rule name. Must be unique among gateway ACLs.
- `policy` (String) `deny` or `permit`.
- `source_ids` (List of String) Source object IDs, e.g. LAN network IDs.

### Optional

- `destination_ids` (List of String) Destination object IDs. Leave empty for destination types that take none.
- `destination_type` (Number) Destination kind. `0` = LAN network, `5` = gateway management (matches **all** traffic addressed to the gateway, including DNS and DHCP; pair it with `protocols = ["tcp"]` unless you mean that).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enforced. Rules saved disabled are listed but do nothing.
- `lan_to_lan` (Boolean) Apply to LAN-to-LAN traffic. Defaults to `true`.
- `lan_to_wan` (Boolean) Apply to LAN-to-WAN traffic. Defaults to `false`.
- `match_states` (Set of String) Connection states to match: `new`, `established`, `related`, `invalid`. Empty matches all packets. `["new"]` on a LAN-to-LAN deny makes it one-way: the source cannot open connections, but replies to connections opened by the other side still pass.
- `protocols` (List of String) Protocols to match: `all`, `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `igmp`, `gre`, `esp`, `ah`, or IP protocol numbers. Defaults to `["all"]`.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `source_type` (Number) Source kind as the controller encodes it. `0` = LAN network (the only value verified on hardware).
- `syslog` (Boolean) Log matches to syslog.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ACL rule ID.
- `index` (Number) 1-based position in the gateway ACL table.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_gateway_acl.staff_to_management Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000001
```
